Responsibilities

In the role of Principal CAD Engineer you will:

  • Lead the build and development of advanced CAD tools and methodologies.
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to successfully implement and integrate CAD solutions.
  • Determine and establish CAD build standards and guidelines.
  • Mentor and guide engineers, encouraging an inclusive and collaborative environment.
  • Coordinate the maintenance and improvement of existing CAD tools to ensure flawless operation.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI/ML, LLMs, or advanced automation techniques to real engineering problems 

Minimum Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in CAD tool development and management.
  • Strong knowledge of semiconductor build and processes.
  • Outstanding problem-solving abilities and the capacity to collaborate effectively within a diverse group.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and C++.

Preferred Qualifications

We highly value candidates with:

  • Experience in handling CAD projects from concept through implementation.
  • Experience with commonly used CAD tools and software in the industry.
  • A track record of mentoring and developing engineers early in their careers.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts.
  • Experience with DRAM or NAND device development.
